title: vault
body: The vault An agent that connects to Gmail, a ticket system or any API needs a key or a login. The vault keeps them: sealed in the chat database ( data/chat.db ), added by a person from the terminal chat, the web page or the command line, and handed to a tool or an MCP server by the runtime at the moment it needs one.
